relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First vulnerability-relevant project statement. When `parse_addr_spec` sees the attacker-controlled semicolon in the To-header body, it fixes the body length and hands the parameter substring plus the original buffer end pointer into `parse_to_param`.
Root cause. The quoted-value escape branch is selected solely by parser state and has no end-of-buffer check before the following line reads `*(tmp + 1)`.
ASan crash site. The quoted-value escape handler dereferences the byte after the current backslash even when the backslash is already the last byte in the buffer.

patch_resolves_note: The official patch.diff does not apply to the staged vulnerable ancestor, so fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative n132/arvo:38080-fix image. On the stock PoC that fixed build reaches quoted_escape_guard with next_char_ptr == end_ptr and never executes quoted_escape_read; the one-byte append_space_after_trailing_backslash case then executes the same read site cleanly with next_char_ptr < end_ptr.
